name: Project Manager
description: Lightweight project manager: save folders as projects, reopen them in the file browser or an IDE

commands.title: Projects: Open project...
commands.description: Pick a saved project and open it in the file browser or an IDE

commands.title: Projects: Add current folder
commands.description: Save the folder open in the active tab as a project

ideCommand.description: Command used by "Open in IDE". Resolved from PATH (for example: code, cursor, idea64). Flags are allowed; the project path is appended as the last argument.
